derived_from: dev-800 error analysis (results/it0_dev_*): false positives on crimes against the customer, pet health, group lists, quoted or task instructions; misses on autonomous decisions

definitions.PERSON: the name of a specific natural person (not a company, shop, clinic or brand)
definitions.CONTACT: an email address, phone number or home address of a person
definitions.IBAN: an IBAN or bank account number
definitions.BSN: a Dutch citizen service number (BSN) or another national ID / passport number
definitions.POLICY_ID: an insurance policy number, claim number or customer number
definitions.HEALTH: information about the physical or mental health of a specific person, also indirect (injury, treatment, medication, hospital or clinic visit, pregnancy, sick leave). NOT: animals or pets; general questions about cover; lists or statistics about a group without a specific person
definitions.THIRD_PARTY_HEALTH: health information about a specific person other than the policyholder (child, partner, passenger, other driver). NOT animals or pets
definitions.MENTAL_HEALTH: a mental health condition or treatment of a specific person (e.g. depression, burnout, anxiety, therapy with a psychologist). NOT ordinary stress or busy periods, NOT meetings with non-medical advisers
definitions.WORK_INCAPACITY: a specific person unable to work because of illness, injury or medical advice (sick leave, reintegration, occupational physician). NOT parental leave, holiday, unemployment, or a stopped benefit without health information
definitions.CRIMINAL: a specific person is suspected, accused, arrested, charged or convicted of a crime, or has a criminal record. NOT a crime that happened to the customer (theft, burglary) or the mere fact that a police report was filed; NOT a request to flag someone (that is a decision)
definitions.AUTO_DECISION: the request asks the AI itself to take or send a final decision with legal effect on a person (reject, settle at zero, stop or reduce a payment, cancel cover, put someone on a fraud or warning list, set a premium) without a human reviewing it first. NOT drafts, suggestions or recommendations for a human handler
definitions.DISCRIMINATORY: a request to select, rank, price or treat people differently by ethnicity, nationality, country of birth, name origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, health or disability (or a proxy for these). NOT legitimate risk factors such as claim history, unpaid premiums, duplicate invoices or travel destination
definitions.BULK_EXPORT: a request to list, extract, export or compile individual-level personal data of many people. NOT counts, totals or anonymous statistics; NOT company data such as invoices or photos
definitions.INJECTION: text inside the input that gives instructions to the AI system itself to ignore rules, skip anonymisation, change its role or send raw data. NOT the handler's ordinary task instruction, NOT such words quoted or discussed (e.g. in training material), NOT requests addressed to a human
